en.headline: Food safety centre orders recall of Kung Wo rose fermented beancurd
en.dek: A sample from a Sham Shui Po retailer contained 140,000 Bacillus cereus per gram, exceeding the unsatisfactory threshold for ready-to-eat food.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Monday that a sample of Kung Wo Bean Curd Factory rose fermented beancurd taken from a Sham Shui Po retailer contained 140,000 Bacillus cereus per gram.

Under the Microbiological Guidelines for Food, ready-to-eat food is considered unsatisfactory if it contains more than 100,000 of the bacteria per gram. The centre has instructed the retailer to stop selling, remove from shelves and recall the affected batch.

Preliminary investigation showed the affected batch comprised only 48 bottles sold between 24 September and 9 October, of which 26 had been sold. The remaining bottles were handed to the centre for disposal. Members of the public were advised to stop consuming the product from the affected batch. Consumption of food containing excessive levels of the bacteria or its heat-stable toxins may cause gastrointestinal symptoms such as vomiting and diarrhoea.

zh.headline: 食安中心指公和玫瑰腐乳含過量蠟樣芽孢桿菌 指示停售回收
zh.dek: 深水埗零售商抽取樣本每克含14萬個蠟樣芽孢桿菌，超出即食食品不滿意水平，受影響批次僅48瓶。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心周一公布，從深水埗一零售商抽取的公和豆品廠玫瑰腐乳樣本，每克含14萬個蠟樣芽孢桿菌。
根據《食品微生物含量指引》，即食食品每克含超過10萬個該菌即屬不滿意。中心已指示涉事零售商將受影響批次停售、下架及回收。
初步調查顯示，該受影響批次產品只有48瓶，於9月24日至10月9日期間在該零售點出售了26瓶，其餘已由零售商交予中心處理及銷毀。中心呼籲市民停止食用受影響批次產品。進食含過量蠟樣芽孢桿菌或其耐熱毒素的食物，可能引致腸胃不適，包括嘔吐及腹瀉。
